**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

Section 18 already meets our preferred insurance position in every material respect:

| Playbook (preferred) | Section 18.1 |
|---|---|
| CGL USD 1M/occurrence, 2M aggregate | ✅ Matches exactly |
| Professional/E&O USD 2M | ✅ Matches |
| Cyber/privacy USD 5M | ✅ Matches |
| Workers' comp as required by law | ✅ Plus employer's liability USD 1M (extra) |
| Certificates on request | ✅ Section 18.2 |

Section 18.1 also carries the coverage through the term **plus one year**, tracking our model language. Section 18.2 adds useful customer-side protections beyond the playbook ask: insurers must be reputable, policies are primary to our own insurance where commercially customary, Vendor must give advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and insurance expressly does not limit Vendor's liabilities.

The clause binds the Vendor and benefits us, so there is nothing to flag.
